card.name: PM after a clock time
card.fires_on: The abbreviation PM right after a clock time such as 5:30 or 02:34. Seen in post timestamps, edit dates and event hours.

modes.label: Timestamps
modes.description: PM ending a date-and-time stamp on a post or page.
modes.example: February 7th, 2011 05:56<< PM>> ET Using marijuana, or cannabis,

modes.label: Event hours
modes.description: PM ending a time or time range for an event or opening hours.
modes.example: Time: 5:30-8:30<< PM>> The rebozo from Santa Maria

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated, though ' UTC' hints at time-zone words.
card.plain: It fires on the PM in a time of day, mostly in web post dates and event times.
